summary: Adding classroom.show_word does not reopen the prior P1 risks. Principal binding, test artifact isolation, replay and commit-unknown contracts remain intact. Two new P2 implementation details should be made explicit: validate the shown word against this lesson's frozen facts and enforce task capability expiry; sanitize panic output after rollback.

findings.title: Store-side same-lesson validation for show_word payload should be explicit
findings.risk: A valid schema and adapter-produced fingerprint do not alone prove the shown word belongs to the frozen facts of the verified lesson.
findings.required_revision: Before inserting receipt/outbox, compare show_word word_id and displayed word against the created checkpoint's frozen words for the exact authorized lesson; reject extra payload fields.

findings.title: Task capability expiry and panic log redaction need explicit enforcement
findings.risk: A lesson-bound capability may be reused after expiry if task scope checks omit expiry; HTTP panic recovery may log panic values/stacks even after the database rollback succeeds.
findings.required_revision: Require now-before-expiry for commit and receipt lookup. After panic unwinding and rollback, recover only at the harness boundary, return a fixed redacted error, and scan panic values/stacks for sentinels; never continue or publish success after panic.

findings.title: Candidate-derived SHA-256 fingerprint remains potentially guessable
findings.location: docs/41 §3 canonical fingerprint; §6 persisted receipt allowlist
findings.risk: A plain hash of low-entropy words/text can be tested offline if returned in a receipt or leaked from persistence/logs.
findings.required_revision: Keep the digest out of browser receipts and ordinary logs; if it crosses trust boundaries, use keyed protection or document owner-only disclosure and that all covered candidate data is non-secret.

execution_capability_review.basis: Executor is typed, test-only, lacks a DB handle, is restricted to classroom.say and classroom.show_word through Registry schema/scope/budget and task-local audit, and the SDD requires bounded pure execution with rollback on error/panic.
conditions: Use one fixed non-configurable test-only implementation; do not select it from requests or runtime configuration.
Keep effects limited to the exact allowlisted schema and frozen lesson-derived payload.
On panic, transaction unwinding must rollback first; the harness boundary must emit only a fixed redacted failure and never report success.
Test that neither task-local audit nor DB/outbox data escapes on errors or panic.

limitations: No tests, runtime checks, build checks, artifact inspection, panic injection, authorization execution, or database inspection were performed.
Approval is limited to the isolated test-only Start design and does not establish implementation correctness or classroom readiness.
